comments.author: @joshTheGoods
comments.text:
Basing your counterargument on an Elon Musk promise was already retarded 5 years ago. Let's look back on it, though, just to drive the point home. Here we are 5 years later, and Tesla are producing batteries with ~250 Wh/kg. Not even fucking close to the promise. Their batteries are lower energy density than the ones they used to buy from Panasonic. In the industry overall (with actually reliable engineers) 300 Wh/kg is the current high for at-scale production. 

Gotta say, this being my first encounter with this channel means I won't be coming back. Weak reasoning, weak evidence, weak content.
